notes.title: Ad Agency Tycoon v0.6
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

Since our last DevLog, we've changed a lot in Ad Agency Tycoon. Lots of basic mechanics, things that have stayed the same since the initial release of Early Access. But once we're done with these changes, we ask ourselves: Are there any others that deserve a little more attention?

In addition to the ad creation system, many elements of the game needed tweaking. Employees. The customizations. Some annoying bugs that have been with us for a while.

So we spent the last 4 months fixing the vast majority of bugs, changing basic mechanics, and everything to turn Ad Agency Tycoon into a new game. A new game for those who thought we needed changes, but also the same game for those who liked the way it was.

[b]Ad Agency Tycoon v0.6 is the first of a long step in restructuring the game, so that we can finally move on to the final release version[/b]. We hope you like it.


List of changes:

- Skill Tree are now Advertising Elements
[list]
[*] No more employees needed for the old skill system!
[*] Discover new advertising features, and customize yours!
[/list]
- Restructuring the creation of advertisements
[list]
[*] No need to advertise in stages anymore
[*] Do all the ad at once, and while it's being produced, do other tasks
[*] You can now see what each Advertising Element does during advertising production!
[*] Feedback? It has its own room now! Put an employee there and get better feedback!
[/list]
- Restructuring of scenario customizations
[list]
[*] Few customizations? Problem solved!
[*] Now the floor is also customizable!
[*] Want a colorful environment? Now each room is individually customizable!
[/list]
- Restructuring of reputation calculation
[list]
[*] Everything more simplified!
[*] It's the average of the ratings of your last 5 advertisements!
[/list]
- Restructuring of the inventory system
[list]
[*] Items disappearing and returning? No more!
[/list]
- Restructuring of the employee system
[list]
[*] Didn't like the Assignments system? It's gone!
[*] Now every employee has skills! Specialize each one and get the best out of them!
[/list]
- Restructuring of the room system
[list]
[*] Fixed rooms? No more!
[*] Your rooms are where you choose! And any color you want!
[/list]
- New Contracts system
[list]
[*] Looking for quick cash? Contracts can be a good option!
[*] Put employees in the Creativity Room, and earn extra income!
[/list]
- Other things
[list]
[*] We don't even know which and how many bugs we fixed, but there were certainly dozens!
[*] Reduced game disk size. We know that our game takes up little space, but it's always good to reduce, isn't it?
[*] New item: Printer.
[/list]

tags.feature: - Skill Tree are now Advertising Elements

tags.bug: - We don't even know which and how many bugs we fixed, but there were certainly dozens!

notes.title: SimFest 2022 & v0.5.1 - Q&A Livestream
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We're glad to announce our participation in SimFest 2022, this event will start on March 28th until April 4th. During this time we will give you 40% off in Ad Agency Tycoon. Plus, we have worked on a new update, so make sure you check it out!

In this new update we are starting to develop a new mechanics system, evolving from the original idea of creating ads, you can now distribute them to different Local Medias. Now you will also have other competing agencies, fighting for influence in these medias.

- Added Competition
- Fixed translations
- Fixed Media Distribution not saving
- Minor optimizations

We will also stream a gameplay with the game developers, on March 30th, at 5:30 PM PST. This will be our first live stream showing our game to the Steam Community, we're really excited! We invite you all for a nice time talking about our game, answering questions and gathering new ideas for future implementations!

tags.bug: - Fixed translations
- Fixed Media Distribution not saving
- Minor optimizations

notes.title: Ad Agency Tycoon v0.5
notes.content:
Hi Players! We're glad to finish another, perhaps our biggest update so far. We are introducing a new mechanics system to make the game more complex, add new features and ways of management.

This update will have a save loss. If you wish to avoid this, you can delete all save files related to feedback. But we recommend starting a new game.

- New Feedback Menu: Delete unused feedbacks, along with better organization to manage your feedbacks.
- Media Distribution: This is our new mechanics, here you'll be able to distribute your ads for your clients to different medias, and with specific Target Audiences (with specific tastes). You'll get pay for it as you increase your client's sales!
- Loan Counter: In debt because you hired a loan? You can now check how much time you have until you need to pay, and you also can pay in advance, with discount!
- New sound effects!
- Updated main character
- Minor optimizations 


Bug fixes:
- Fixed the game freezing when changing to a new scenario
- Fixed bug when hiring feedback for completed companies
- Fixed typos and translations
- Fixed a bug that could cause the "Bad Ad" achievement to pop-up

notes.title: Is it Halloween yet? Thematic event with new implementations!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We entered the Halloween period, and with that, Ad Agency Tycoon joins the event! We changed the theme of the game to something a little more... dark, but nothing that scares the players, we guarantee that. Ad Agency Tycoon also joins the sale on the Steam store, so if you're interested in the game, it's an opportunity to purchase at a lower price!

In addition to the seasonal theme, we decided to open our Discord so that players can have a more direct and efficient communication with us, developers, and able to contribute to the development of the game. To access our Discord, access the following invitation link: [url=https://discord.gg/ba3Q48]Discord Invite[/url]
With the opening of the media, our Open Docs with all the texts of the game will be available soon so that the community can contribute to the progress of the game and in return, earn some rewards. We will set the rules soon so that those who wish to, attractively aware of the rules.

Below, as update notes for the seasonal theme, and then as general update notes:

Halloween:
[list]
[*] Darker theme and with cobwebs in the scene
[*] New company: Candy Shop
[*] New item: Pumpkin Head
[/list]

General:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug when reaching the maximum level
[*] Reduced game size by 12%
[*] Reduced game load time by 40%
[*] New item: The Lonely Octopus
[*] The scene zoom has now returned to normal operation, using the middle mouse button
[*] When purchasing an item, you can now choose where to place the object on the stage. Complementary implementations to this will be added next week.
[/list]

If you find bugs, or want to make suggestions, use the Steam forums, or our Discord.

~Kaminski

-    The turn shifts are now visible next to the clock animation
-    Now less XP is needed to level up
-    Better and clearer tutorials
-    New Game and Load Game button in the main menu
-    Fixed: not loading translation correctly
-    Fixed: not deleting the saved games after a game over
-    Fixed: ‘Sold Out’ and ‘Hired’ status were not showed correctly in Scenario 2
-    Fixed: not saving volume choice in ‘options’ after reloading the game
-    Fixed: Tutorial kept showing up at the beginning up after finished
-    Fixed: Road Map button did not work correctly
-    Fixed: not being able to progress in the game
-    Minor optimizations
-    Some grammar mistakes were noticed and fixed

~Kaminski
